mapper.select: SELECT symbol, name, market, sector FROM ( SELECT symbol, name, market, sector, CASE WHEN UPPER(symbol) = UPPER(#{q}) THEN 0 WHEN UPPER(symbol) LIKE UPPER(#{q}) || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS ord FROM universe WHERE UPPER(name) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{q}) || '%' OR UPPER(symbol) LIKE UPPER(#{q}) || '%' UNION ALL SELECT symbol, name, market, NULL AS sector, CASE WHEN UPPER(symbol) = UPPER(#{q}) THEN 0 WHEN UPPER(symbol) LIKE UPPER(#{q}) || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS ord FROM us_universe WHERE UPPER(name) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{q}) || '%' OR UPPER(symbol) LIKE UPPER(#{q}) || '%' ) ORDER BY ord, LENGTH(name) FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY
